reason: Pre-alpha from one developer, with nobody I know running it. I can get most of this with a cron job, claude -p and a GitHub Action, so I'll wait and see who else trusts it.
objection: A single-maintainer pre-alpha tool running agents unattended on our machines with our client repos. If he stops, we are stuck with pipelines in his format.
would_change_my_mind: A few agencies like ours publicly showing months of overnight PRs that actually merged, plus a real contributor base on GitHub.
